measurement: Byte-equal substantive spans of at least three lines; eligibility unchanged from C3 native-only core. Fifth credit additionally intersects the PM-approved net candidate source ranges. Safe changed lines, tests, Dart, resources, helpers without consumers and supporting UI are not credited. Same-path byte-equal C3 provenance is known; equivalent/cross-path past provenance is unknown, so net new vs C3 is not an assertion that all such lines were absent semantically.

known_byte_equal_origin_sets.boundary: P is only verified byte-equal same-path baseline provenance under the same native source eligibility filter, not all previous batches or asserted old binary linkage. Cross-path/equivalent-derived baseline remains unknown. N is exact relative to known P only. References never form P; the extra reference-subtracted fourth-new lower bound is a separate non-additive quantity.

qualification_evidence.status: Current iOS native/ordinary unsigned Release/exact real controlled HTTPS and Mini SDK consumer admission; independent final QA/cross conclusions are recorded separately.
qualification_evidence.rule: Only primary executable native runtime core paths with current target SHA exactly matching unchanged ordinary Release build inputs are admitted. Headers, declaration-only, known no-caller network helpers, local adapters, resources, tests, Dart and release-excluded source lines do not count. This is module/source provenance, not a claim that each source line has a separate retained machine-code instruction or was individually executed.

ios.boundary: Real task-private simulator UIKit/WK/HTTPS/Dart SDK consumers, not individual method/line execution or physical-device evidence.

native_entry_chains.ios: GeneratedPluginRegistrant -> StminiFlutterPlugin.register/handle -> explicit HTTPS Mini download/install/warm background update and immutable runtime snapshot; local Mini/cache/transition; standalone HTTPS Web; original document/session/channel/JS marker boundary.

platform_scope.ios: Sixth explicit HTTPS Mini download/ZIP installation/weak and mandatory updates with immutable snapshot; preserves fifth lifecycle/Web/transition. No Camera/scanner/production URL/product Mini entry.
platform_scope.android: Unchanged foundation baseline; no new native validation or iOS source credit.

qualification_evidence.artifact_boundary: Current local unsigned ordinary main iOS App/framework only. No signed IPA, upload/store approval, production Mini, physical device or actual Photos/share side-effect qualification.

safe_derived_boundary: Operation cancellation, immutable runtime snapshots, lifecycle/owner/session guards, tests, Dart, ZIPFoundation and no-consumer mirror receive zero fixed-source credit. Non-equal source positions do not mean unimplemented behavior or semantic loss. This is not a work-completion or functionality percentage.
signed_ipa_boundary: Only current local ordinary unsigned Release plus controlled consumers can qualify. Signed IPA, physical-device and store evidence remain separate.
